description: The complete set of things of one type as of one instant: a ban list, the peers of a tunnel. A thing present in one snapshot and absent from the next has left. Several providers may be active at once.

functions.description: Called at every probe round: asks the firewall whether this implementation can be read and whether its configuration serves clients.
functions.name: probe

functions.description: Called at the plugin's cadence: every set the provider reports, each complete.
functions.name: snapshot

fields.description: Why the probe could not finish, when it could not.
fields.name: error

fields.description: Why the read failed, when it did.
fields.name: error

fields.description: Which set: a lower-case word with no space.
fields.name: set_key

fields.description: The `state_item` records; an empty list is a set that is now empty.
fields.name: items

fields.description: The provider's own fields, displayed and never aggregated.
fields.name: attributes

fields.description: The end of its own validity, when the provider states one.
fields.name: valid_until_at
